name: Prediction-only Lasso distribution screen
authorization: User explicitly requests feature importance, simple Lasso training and comparison with calibrated market; no MIO.
method: Separate ordinary L1-penalized least-squares regression for CDF indicators at z=-6,-5.5,...,6. One shared alpha, selected by 13-node twCRPS on each historical monitor. No market-offset or output blending.
feature_caveat: 106 is the historical inventory and includes unresolved open-interest source-clock fields. 65 reproduces the current selected input list. Importance is standardized Lasso coefficient magnitude, not causal importance or established out-of-sample value.
null: Exact intercept-only fitted CDF is included in penalty selection; ties prefer null, then larger alpha.
importance: sqrt(sum(primary threshold weights * standardized coefficient squared)); report each fold and stability. Lasso itself selects nonzero inputs; no selection using 2020-2023 scores.
preprocess: Per-fit training means for missing-value imputation and per-fit training population SD. Constant inputs set zero. No outcome-dependent row exclusion.
cdf: Clip fitted probabilities to [0,1], sort within each row for monotonicity, piecewise-linear interpolate with fixed endpoints (-10,0),(10,1).
folds: Exact original106 fit/monitor quote and settlement date bands and known-symbol list from metadata, warmup 2019 then annual 2020-2023. Do not refit on monitor. Original fit counts must match. All model selection completed and models hashed before test scoring.
evaluation: Same 449498 market-eligible identities as saved original106 scores in 2020-2023; compare calibrated market, raw market, per-name and pooled empirical. Warmup never ranks. Two-way expiry/symbol 95% paired intervals; annual consistency.
secondary: Full-distribution CRPS from 401 midpoint quantiles using existing ChronologicalCDFStudy.scores; 5/95% tail PIT and primary threshold Brier. Finite-tail CDF construction is fixed before scoring.
selection_exposure: Validation was already exposed in prior work; this is retrospective development, not untouched proof. 2024+ remains sealed.
exit: Fit the two prespecified Lasso variants, validate numerical solver, report feature ranks and validation outcomes including nulls; no promotion or adaptive additional family.
host: WSL2; two numerical threads; streaming 16384-row batches; estimated peak <1 GiB and writes <150MB. Windows free physical 2.7GiB, C free28.06GiB, WSL free22.8GB (not additive). Mac online but transfer/setup offers no benefit for small Gram solves.
sweep: 59 refs/125 worktrees scanned; no corresponding distribution Lasso study found. Sweep mention phase hit known 0.05s timeout. Existing sklearn lars_path_gram, GridCurve and ChronologicalCDFStudy scores inventoried.
production_changes: None. Analysis artifacts only; no shared registry, input, or checkpoint writes.
solver: sklearn lasso_path coordinate descent on a compact factorization of training-only sufficient statistics, verified against direct Lasso predictions and original-statistics KKT. Exact same L1 objective, alpha grid and data.

top10_supplement.reason: User requested a simple Lasso using important features; unrestricted Lasso retained 28-62 fields. Freeze a bounded ten-feature version before viewing any annual scores.
top10_supplement.feature_selection: Within each historical fit/monitor, select the ten largest weighted coefficient norms from Lasso106; refit ordinary Lasso on those ten with the same alpha grid and historical monitor. No change to the first two fitted variants.
